rejected.text: Thunder Junction is the Wild West plane of outlaws, deserts and Omenpaths, home of Stella Lee and the setting of Outlaws of Thunder Junction.
Yuma built a new life there on a plane that was still beginning, and the Fomori vault stands there, where Jace and Vraska meet with Loot.
The material lists no events for Thunder Junction; its latest mention, in September 2026, names it as a plane Vraska and Jace considered bringing Garruk to.
